name: SenClaw CRM
description: A personal CRM Space App: a single source of truth for customer information — name, avatar, contact, company, tags, pipeline status, notes — plus a chronological log of every touchpoint (calls, emails, meetings, notes). Search and filter by tag or status, upload an avatar (or paste a URL), and let the AI briefing summarize who a customer is and suggest the next action. The bundled MCP exposes every CRUD operation so any SenClaw agent can look up a customer, log an interaction, or draft outreach from real stored context.

mcp.name: crm-mcp
mcp.description: SenClaw CRM MCP: full read/write coverage of the CRM. Customers (13 roles: lead, prospect, customer, VIP, contact, partner, referrer, supplier, investor, employee, former, paused, lost) with avatar (URL or base64), tags, notes. Interactions (call/email/meeting/note/task/profile_update/deal_update). Deals across Kanban pipeline (qualifying → proposal → negotiation → won/lost). Tasks + reminders + upcoming feed (birthdays + due tasks). Directed relationship graph (11 kinds: referred_by, introduced_by, colleague_of, spouse_of, family_of, friend_of, reports_to, partner_of, supplier_of, competitor_of, contact_of), path finder (BFS shortest path + AI qualitative connections), similar-customer ranking, AI graph extraction from notes, AI common-theme discovery. FTS5 diacritic-folded full-text search across all data. Calendar sync (bi-directional with luna-calendar + event-space). Aggregate AI report + per-customer AI briefing. 36+ tools cover 100% of the app's write and query surface.
